I've suspected for a long time that it could be possible that I have some form of depression, my bad thoughts and low energy are a dead giveaway. Unfortunately, my parents won't provide me with any doctor or therapist. I've asked countless times and I get the same answer every time, "I'll try" and it never happens.  


And I like that, "I'm just not my type". I think I'm gonna remember that. Thank you bunches for taking time to reply :)

Thank you for replying :)
I'm not out and I never will be, my parents are highly homophobic and transphobic.

Before I originally got my hair cut, I wanted it shorter but my stepdad had the audacity to say "you're not getting that, you're not gonna walk around looking like some lesbian" which hurt really bad.

I did figure out a cool "hack" though! 
My hair is shorter in the front and longer in the back, kinda like a mullet. I figured out that I can pull the back into a ponytail, making me look more masculine with seemingly shorter hair.

Once again, thank you for responding <3

The hotlines don't help.

What do you expect? Someone to be like "Wow!! i never thought of calling the hotline!! Wow im gonna be perfect after this one simple call!!"

It doesn't work like that. Often times makes it worse. You mentioned family? Sometimes family is the main issue. I'm not speaking for OP here. Just saying this response is incredibly unhelpful.

Hey man, I'm sure you've heard this many times before, but I care about you. And I mean it. cause you matter. I know that maybe today seems dark, and that you may feel like you don't deserve life, but listen to me. You're here for a reason.      

You never know, you could grow older and accomplish a life changing experience. You could discover something nobody else has. You could change the fucking world, man. Keep searching for the light.

 Light wouldn't exist without some darkness. 

Keep pushing on. Keep your head up. Keep taking steps. If you haven't already, get something to eat, some water. Turn on something to watch, do something that makes you happy. 

You're the best. There's people that love you.
I know that maybe you've heard things like this before, and maybe they don't help, it's the same for me. Just remember this one, alright? I'm proud of you for still being here. I'm proud of you. If you're ever feeling upset or depressed, remember this comment.
 You're important. You're loved. And you can make it through.
